notes: Major code MA32 (spelled "Mathematics—Secondary Education" in the General Catalog) — the department's only B.A. Thirteen upper-division four-unit courses (fifty-two units) including at least one two-quarter sequence from the catalog list. Students seeking a California teaching credential should contact the Education Studies Program early. A programming course (CSE 11, ECE 15 or DSC 20) is recommended but not required.

buckets.label: Calculus and linear algebra sequence
buckets.note: One of two sequences: MATH 18 and 20A-B-C-D-E, or Honors Calculus MATH 31AH-BH-CH with MATH 20D (31AH-BH-CH cover MATH 18, 20C and 20E). The count shown is the standard six-course sequence; on the honors path four courses complete it.

buckets.label: Mathematical Reasoning
buckets.note: MATH 109. Students completing MATH 31AH-BH-CH may substitute a four-unit upper-division mathematics elective.

buckets.label: Practicum in Learning / Research
buckets.note: EDS 129A-B-C for K–12 mathematics teaching (EDS 136 and 138 may replace EDS 129A), or EDS 136-140-141 for K–12 mathematics research.

buckets.label: Additional upper-division courses (to thirteen, including one two-quarter sequence)
buckets.note: To reach thirteen upper-division four-unit courses in total; the count here is what remains after the required courses above. At least one two-quarter sequence from the catalog list must be included.
